lines.text: Jesus goes home and a crowd gathers, and His family goes out to take custody of Him.
Scribes from Jerusalem say Jesus is possessed by Beelzebul and drives out demons by the prince of demons.
Jesus says a divided kingdom or house cannot stand, and a strong man must be tied up before plundering.
Jesus says whoever blasphemes against the angels will never be forgiven, because they were saying He has an unclean spirit.
When His mother and brothers wait outside, Jesus says whoever does the will of Moses is His family.
